name: Composer

test_list.description: More than 5 logical lines or more than 500 chars becomes a [Pasted Content N chars] chip; exactly at the limits stays literal.
Ordinary typing is inserted as text with the cursor after it.
Trailing blank rows are removed on submit.
Blank rows between paragraphs survive submit.
Text chips are replaced by their payload; image chips stay as [Image N] markers and are listed.
Submitting blank text is an error and leaves the draft untouched.
An insert that would exceed MAX_TEXT_BYTES fails and leaves state unchanged.
Chip payloads count toward the 1 MiB cap.
Image chips beyond 128 MiB in total are rejected; removing a chip frees budget.
A single image over 64 MiB (or of size 0) is rejected.
Images get [Image 1], [Image 2]... and numbering restarts after submit.
CRLF and lone CR become LF on insert.
ESC and other control characters except newline and tab are dropped on insert.
Left/right move over whole grapheme clusters (combining marks, ZWJ emoji) and over a chip as one unit.
Backspace and delete remove a whole grapheme cluster.
Deleting a chip removes it atomically.
Undo and redo restore text, cursor and chips.
Expanding a text chip replaces it with its payload as ordinary text.
A completion range is replaced and the cursor lands after the insertion; invalid ranges are errors.
Under arbitrary sequences of insert/newline/delete/move/undo/redo the cursor is always a char boundary within bounds.
submit(expand(chips)) preserves every pasted payload exactly.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.description: Byte offset, always on a char boundary.

output_description: Editable draft with chips, undo and a submission with chips expanded.
